scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client "npm run dev -w @sc/server" "npm run dev -w @sc/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sc/shared && npm run build -w @sc/client && npm run build -w @sc/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p packages/server --noEmit && tsc -p packages/client --noEmit
